22: class WebsocketsProtocolTransportBase(SubscriptionTransportBase):
23:     """:ref:`Async Transport <async_transports>` used to execute GraphQL queries on
24:     remote servers with websocket connection.
25: 
26:     This transport uses asyncio and the provided websockets adapter library
27:     in order to send requests on a websocket connection.
28:     """
29: 
30:     # This transport supports two subprotocols and will autodetect the
31:     # subprotocol supported on the server
32:     APOLLO_SUBPROTOCOL = "graphql-ws"
33:     GRAPHQLWS_SUBPROTOCOL = "graphql-transport-ws"
34: 
35:     def __init__(
36:         self,
37:         *,
38:         adapter: AdapterConnection,
39:         init_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
40:         connect_timeout: Optional[Union[int, float]] = 10,
41:         close_timeout: Optional[Union[int, float]] = 10,
42:         ack_timeout: Optional[Union[int, float]] = 10,
43:         keep_alive_timeout: Optional[Union[int, float]] = None,
44:         ping_interval: Optional[Union[int, float]] = None,
45:         pong_timeout: Optional[Union[int, float]] = None,
46:         answer_pings: bool = True,
47:         subprotocols: Optional[List[str]] = None,
48:     ) -> None:
49:         """Initialize the transport with the given parameters.
50: 
51:         :param adapter: The connection dependency adapter
52:         :param init_payload: Dict of the payload sent in the connection_init message.
53:         :param connect_timeout: Timeout in seconds for the establishment
54:             of the websocket connection. If None is provided this will wait forever.
55:         :param close_timeout: Timeout in seconds for the close. If None is provided
56:             this will wait forever.
57:         :param ack_timeout: Timeout in seconds to wait for the connection_ack message
58:             from the server. If None is provided this will wait forever.
59:         :param keep_alive_timeout: Optional Timeout in seconds to receive
60:             a sign of liveness from the server.
61:         :param ping_interval: Delay in seconds between pings sent by the client to
62:             the backend for the graphql-ws protocol. None (by default) means that
63:             we don't send pings. Note: there are also pings sent by the underlying
64:             websockets protocol. See the
65:             :ref:`keepalive documentation <websockets_transport_keepalives>`
66:             for more information about this.
67:         :param pong_timeout: Delay in seconds to receive a pong from the backend
68:             after we sent a ping (only for the graphql-ws protocol).
69:             By default equal to half of the ping_interval.
70:         :param answer_pings: Whether the client answers the pings from the backend
71:             (for the graphql-ws protocol).
72:             By default: True
73:         :param subprotocols: list of subprotocols sent to the
74:             backend in the 'subprotocols' http header.
75:             By default: both apollo and graphql-ws subprotocols.
76:         """
77: 
78:         if subprotocols is None:
79:             subprotocols = [
80:                 self.APOLLO_SUBPROTOCOL,
81:                 self.GRAPHQLWS_SUBPROTOCOL,
82:             ]
83: 
84:         self.adapter.subprotocols = subprotocols
85: 
86:         # Initialize the generic SubscriptionTransportBase parent class
87:         super().__init__(
88:             adapter=self.adapter,
89:             connect_timeout=connect_timeout,
90:             close_timeout=close_timeout,
91:             keep_alive_timeout=keep_alive_timeout,
92:         )
93: 
94:         if init_payload is None:
95:             init_payload = {}
96: 
97:         self.init_payload: Dict[str, Any] = init_payload
98:         self.ack_timeout: Optional[Union[int, float]] = ack_timeout
99: 
100:         self.payloads: Dict[str, Any] = {}
101:         """payloads is a dict which will contain the payloads received
102:         for example with the graphql-ws protocol: 'ping', 'pong', 'connection_ack'"""
103: 
104:         self.ping_interval: Optional[Union[int, float]] = ping_interval
105:         self.pong_timeout: Optional[Union[int, float]]
106:         self.answer_pings: bool = answer_pings
107: 
108:         if ping_interval is not None:
109:             if pong_timeout is None:
110:                 self.pong_timeout = ping_interval / 2
111:             else:
112:                 self.pong_timeout = pong_timeout
113: 
114:         self.send_ping_task: Optional[asyncio.Future] = None
115: 
116:         self.ping_received: asyncio.Event = asyncio.Event()
117:         """ping_received is an asyncio Event which will fire  each time
118:         a ping is received with the graphql-ws protocol"""
119: 
120:         self.pong_received: asyncio.Event = asyncio.Event()
121:         """pong_received is an asyncio Event which will fire  each time
122:         a pong is received with the graphql-ws protocol"""

124:     async def _wait_ack(self) -> None:
125:         """Wait for the connection_ack message. Keep alive messages are ignored"""
126: 
127:         while True:
128:             init_answer = await self._receive()
129: 
130:             answer_type, answer_id, execution_result = self._parse_answer(init_answer)
131: 
132:             if answer_type == "connection_ack":
133:                 return
134: 
135:             if answer_type != "ka":
136:                 raise TransportProtocolError(
137:                     "Websocket server did not return a connection ack"
138:                 )
139: 
140:     async def _send_init_message_and_wait_ack(self) -> None:
141:         """Send init message to the provided websocket and wait for the connection ACK.
142: 
143:         If the answer is not a connection_ack message, we will return an Exception.
144:         """
145: 
146:         init_message = json.dumps(
147:             {"type": "connection_init", "payload": self.init_payload}
148:         )
149: 
150:         await self._send(init_message)
151: 
152:         # Wait for the connection_ack message or raise a TimeoutError
153:         await asyncio.wait_for(self._wait_ack(), self.ack_timeout)
154: 
155:     async def _initialize(self):
156:         await self._send_init_message_and_wait_ack()
